name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have join {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a.Subset (c ++ [h1])) (hb : b.Subset (d ++ [h1])) :
      (a ++ b).Subset ((c ++ d) ++ [h1]) := by
    simp only [List.Subset, List.mem_append] at *
    intro x hx
    exact hx.elim
      (fun h => (ha h).elim (fun h => Or.inl (Or.inl h)) Or.inr)
      (fun h => (hb h).elim (fun h => Or.inl (Or.inr h)) Or.inr)
  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars]
  induction post <;> simp only [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
  case const => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case bvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case fvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case op => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant trih eih => exact join trih eih
  case ite cih tih eih => exact join (join cih tih) eih
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
      · exact List.subset_append_left _ _
    · exact join ih1 ih2

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have app {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h : a.Subset c) (h' : b.Subset d) :
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) :=
    List.Subset.app (List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h)
      (List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ h')
  intro h
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar => exact List.nil_subset _
  | abs _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ ih₁ ih₂ | eq _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact app ih₁ ih₂
  | ite _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ => exact app (app ih₁ ih₂) ih₃
  | app _ _ h ih₁ ih₂ =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact List.Subset.refl _
    · next hfalse =>
      cases h .oldPred
      exact False.elim (hfalse _ _ _ rfl)
    · exact app ih₁ ih₂

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have Hlen := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have Hlen' := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hnone := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit Hlen'
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' Hnone Hup) (InitStatesNodup Hinit), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate Hlen
      (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))
  · rw [List.unzip_zip Hlen, List.unzip_zip Hlen']
    intro k hk hk'
    have Hsome := UpdateStatesDefined Hup k hk
    simpa [Hnone k hk'] using Hsome

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  change f x₀ = 0
  by_contra hx₀
  have hinner : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' _ _ hf continuous_const
  have hpos : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg'
      (fun h => hx₀ (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm))
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hinner.continuousAt hpos)
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := φ.continuous.mul hinner
  have hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : dist x x₀ < r
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hball hx).le
    · rw [φ.zero_of_le_dist (le_of_not_gt hx), zero_mul]
  have hp := integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero hc
    (hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right (μ := μ)) hn
    (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)) hpos).ne'
  have hz := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  exact hp.ne' hz

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  have hG : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => ∂[i] f x)
      (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
    change fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x (Space.basis i) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y / 𝓕.ε₀) x (Space.basis i) at hg
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt] at hg
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hg
    rw [fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt] at hg
    simpa only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] using hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1]
    change fun s => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) s
    enter [s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Time.deriv_eq]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i))]
    enter [2, y]
    rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_fun_sub (hEd i j).differentiableAt (hEd j i).differentiableAt]
    simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hG, FreeSpace.c_sq]
  field_simp

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  have ha := Basis.mem_span (ofCrAnListFBasis (𝓕 := 𝓕)) a
  have hb := Basis.mem_span (ofCrAnListFBasis (𝓕 := 𝓕)) b
  induction ha, hb using Submodule.span_induction₂ with
  | mem_mem a b ha hb =>
    rcases ha with ⟨l, rfl⟩
    rcases hb with ⟨r, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let L := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        ((l ++ r).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)) ++
      (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) l)
    let R := (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) r) ++
      (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        ((l ++ r).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))
    have hs (m : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
        (hm : ∀ c ∈ m, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
        crAnTimeOrderList (l ++ m ++ r) = L ++ m ++ R := by
      simpa only [crAnTimeOrderList, L, R, List.append_assoc, decide_not,
        Bool.decide_and] using insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ l m r hm
    have h0 : crAnTimeOrderList (l ++ r) = L ++ R := by
      simpa only [List.append_nil, List.nil_append] using hs [] (by simp)
    have hc : [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF =
        ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ] - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ] := by
      rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
        superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [List.singleton_append, ofList_singleton]
    have hswap : crAnTimeOrderSign (l ++ [ψ, φ] ++ r) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (l ++ [φ, ψ] ++ r) := by
      simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] using
        (crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ l r).symm
    calc
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (l ++ [φ, ψ] ++ r) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF L) * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            ι (ofCrAnListF R)) := by
        conv_lhs =>
          rw [hc]
          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
            ← ofCrAnListF_append, map_sub, map_smul,
            timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        rw [hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]), hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])]
        simp only [hc, hswap, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, map_sub, map_smul,
          mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
          smul_sub, mul_assoc]
        congr 1
        exact smul_comm _ _ _
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (l ++ [φ, ψ] ++ r) •
          (ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (l ++ r)))) := by
        rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
          mul_assoc, ← map_mul ι (ofCrAnListF L) (ofCrAnListF R),
          ← ofCrAnListF_append L R, ← h0]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, map_smul,
          Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
        by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
        · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
        · have he : 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ := (not_ne_iff.mp hq).symm
          have ht := Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ he l r
          simpa only [crAnTimeOrderSign, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append,
            List.nil_append] using congrArg
              (fun c => c • (ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
                ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (l ++ r))))) ht
  | zero_left _ _ | zero_right _ _ =>
    simp only [zero_mul, mul_zero, map_zero]
  | add_left x y z hx hy hz ih₁ ih₂ | add_right x y z hx hy hz ih₁ ih₂ =>
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, map_add, ih₁, ih₂]
  | smul_left c x y hx hy ih | smul_right c x y hx hy ih =>
    simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, ih]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp at mem
  case abs L d _ => exact .inl (.abs (Typing.abs L d).wf.2.1)
  case tabs L d _ => exact .inl (.tabs (Typing.tabs L d).wf.2.1)
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl with vl | ⟨s, h⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl with vr | ⟨s, h⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
        exact ⟨_, .abs vl.lc vr⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ vl h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp d sub ih =>
    have hs := (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨s, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc hs⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp hs h⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L d h ih _ =>
    have hb : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    right
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨s, hr⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body v hb⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind hr hb⟩
  case inl _ _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨s, h⟩
    · exact .inl (.inl v)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inl h⟩
  case inr _ _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨s, h⟩
    · exact .inl (.inr v)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inr h⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ L d h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have b₂ : t₂.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₂ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    have b₃ : t₃.body := ⟨L, fun x hx => (h₃ x hx).wf.2.1⟩
    right
    rcases ih rfl with v | ⟨s, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨s, e | e⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v
      · subst e
        cases v with
        | inl v => exact ⟨_, .case_inl v b₂ b₃⟩
      · subst e
        cases v with
        | inr v => exact ⟨_, .case_inr v b₂ b₃⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h b₂ b₃⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨a₃, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨b₃, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible _ ha]
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hc⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      obtain ⟨a', c', ha', hc', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par ha' hb) (.par hc' hb)⟩
  case red_I a =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case par c a' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible _ hc]
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K a c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨a₁', h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨a', b', ha, hb, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par ha hc) (.par hb hc), .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor <;> intro s' ht
    · cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨t', Tr.choiceL ht', .bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨t', Tr.choiceL ht', .bisim h'⟩
      | choiceR ht =>
        exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    constructor <;> intro s' ht
    · obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨t', ht', .bisim h'⟩
    · obtain ⟨t', ht', h'⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨t', ht', .bisim h'⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let D := fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem
    (show (D '' Set.univ).Nonempty from Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  have hfw : 2 * Y.ncard ≤
      2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    apply ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp
    change 2 * (D g : ℕ∞) < (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ : ℕ∞)
    rw [hg]
    exact h_fw_dist_lt
  let fibers := fun y : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ =>
    Finset.univ.image
      (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) y)
  have hdist : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    apply le_trans (b := (Y.toFinset.biUnion fibers).card)
    · apply Finset.card_le_card
      intro x hx
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
        ⟨iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, Finset.mem_univ _,
          (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    · apply Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul
      intro y hy
      exact Finset.card_image_le.trans_eq (Finset.card_fin _)
  have hmul : 2 * hammingDist f g ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val) - 2 ^ (ℓ - i.val) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * (Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hdist
      _ = (2 * Y.ncard) * 2 ^ steps := (Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) * 2 ^ steps :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hfw
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add,
          show ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val by omega,
          show ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val by omega]
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmul)

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval
      (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hdiff : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have heval (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have hsplit := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
    simp only [P_i, hsplit, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, hq,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P₀, P₁]
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * ((1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 1).val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fiberMap 0).val) = _
  rw [heval 0, heval 1]
  calc
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal) *
        ((fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [hdiff, mul_one]
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
        Polynomial.eval_C]
      rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero => exact fun h => (Nat.lt_irrefl 0 h).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      intro _ u hp
      simp_rw [zero_add, multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
        prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
      have h := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
      have hu : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      simp only [jointProximityNat₂, Fin.isValue] at h
      rw [← hu] at h
      exact h
    | succ n =>
      intro _ u hp
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form (u := u)] at hp
      have hs := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (P := multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close MC u e)
      dsimp only [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close, Fin.init] at hs hp
      erw [hs] at hp
      have hR := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e hp
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ (n + 1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hR (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F) _ _ ?_)
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (MC := MC)
        (ih := ih (Nat.succ_pos _)) (u := u) ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f : ℕ → Fin 4 → Set.Icc B T :=
    fun n k => ⟨u (n + k), hB (n + k)⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hf⟩ := Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (f := f) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have h : ∀ m : ℕ, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      by_cases hm : m < 4
      · exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hf ⟨m, hm⟩)
      · have hp : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → k ≤ 4 →
            u (i + m - k) = u (j + m - k) := by
          intro k hk hk4
          simpa only [Nat.add_sub_assoc (show k ≤ m by omega)] using
            ih (m - k) (by omega)
        apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
        rw [(hu (i + m) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + m) (by omega)).1,
          hp 1 (by decide) (by decide), hp 2 (by decide) (by decide),
          hp 3 (by decide) (by decide), hp 4 (by decide) (by decide)]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hn,
    show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) by omega] using (h (n - i)).symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hm (A : Set S) (hA : A ∉ P) : ∃ U ∈ P, A ∩ U = ∅ := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hPS ⟨A, hA, fun U hU => (h U hU).ne_empty⟩
  have hc (A : Set S) : Aᶜ ∈ P ↔ A ∉ P := by
    constructor
    · intro hAc hA
      exact hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc (Set.inter_compl_self A)
    · intro hA
      by_contra hAc
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hu⟩ := hm A hA
      obtain ⟨V, hV, hv⟩ := hm Aᶜ hAc
      obtain ⟨x, hxU, hxV⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hPP U hU V hV)
      by_cases hx : x ∈ A
      · exact Set.notMem_empty x (hu ▸ ⟨hx, hxU⟩)
      · exact Set.notMem_empty x (hv ▸ ⟨hx, hxV⟩)
  have heq : P.card = (Pᶜ).card := by
    apply Finset.card_bijective (compl : Set S → Set S) compl_bijective
    intro A
    simp only [Finset.mem_compl, hc, not_not]
  have hcard := Finset.card_add_card_compl P
  rw [← heq, Fintype.card_set,
    ← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Fintype.card_pos (α := S)), pow_succ,
    ← Nat.mul_two] at hcard
  exact Nat.mul_right_cancel (by decide : 0 < 2) hcard

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have hs (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        digits_to_num a + (b i - a i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (a j * 10 ^ j.1 +
          if j = i then (b j - a j) * 10 ^ j.1 else 0) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        split_ifs <;> ring
      _ = _ := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩
  have hd := ((hrelation d e).mp hde).2
  have he := ((hrelation e f).mp hef).2
  simp only [hs] at hd he
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have ht := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
    have hdiff : (∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1) =
        digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d := by
      simp only [hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hdiff, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at ht
    omega
  intro i
  have hc : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩
  apply (hc.pow_right (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  convert dvd_sub hsum (dvd_add (hd i) (he i)) using 1 <;> ring
